title: cheilanthes farinosa var. grisea
intro: Cheilanthes farinosa var. grisea, commonly known as Rustyback Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in Native American and Asian cultures, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cheilanthes farinosa var. grisea include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
